title: Testable price rules
description:
Write pricing logic that is easy to test, with tests written as plain checks.

```
PASS no discount under 50
PASS 10% off from 50
PASS member gets 5% more
PASS never below zero
4 of 4 tests passed
```
hints: Arrange, act, assert: each test sets up one input, calls `Final` once and checks one result (lesson 6.02).
The real project would use xUnit (`[Fact]` and `Assert.Equal`); the runner here does the same job without a package.
requirements: `static class Pricing` with `decimal Final(decimal total, bool member)`: 10% off from 50.00, members 5% more off, never negative.
A tiny test runner: `Test(string name, Action body)` prints PASS or FAIL with the exception message.
At least four tests, each with one clear expectation.
stretch: Add `[Theory]`-style data: a list of `(input, member, expected)` tuples, each run as its own test.
